verse.verse_1: Say (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him) to these Mushrikun and Kafirun): "O Al-Kafirun (disbelievers in Allah, in His Oneness, in His Angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Resurrection, and in Al-Qadar, etc.)!
verse.verse_2: "I worship not that which you worship,
verse.verse_3: "Nor will you worship that which I worship.
verse.verse_4: "And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping.
verse.verse_5: "Nor will you worship that which I worship.
verse.verse_6: "To you be your religion, and to me my religion (Islamic Monotheism)."
